item.title: Labour MP proposes ban on sale of "monster" e-bikes and illegal conversion kits to "remove dangerous products before they reach our streets"
item.description: "E-bikes, when they conform to the law, are a force for good... what this bill does is introduce measured necessary steps to make our streets safer and stop the sale of monster e-bikes"

item.title: "How would you feel about a random person breathing down your neck at work?": Pro cyclist frustrated by Vingegaard training crash, tells fans to ask if they want to ride on the wheel; "I've never understood the hate for cyclists" + more on the live blog
item.description: Dan Alexander will be taking you through the midway point in the week with the usual eclectic mix of news, views, reaction and plenty of silliness from the world of cycling this Wednesday

item.title: Megamo Reach HT 10 Equipped
item.description: Tons of power on tap with off-road and load-hauling capability 8/10

item.title: Police confirm U-turn on controversial policy not to investigate stolen bikes left outside train stations for more than two hours
item.description: The British Transport Police say the policy change shows they "are committed to bringing more bike thieves to justice in 2026 than ever before"

item.title: Salsa Cycles and Wolf Tooth join Minnesota cycling community in remembering man killed by ICE agents
item.description: Alex Pretti was the second person shot dead by federal agents in Minneapolis in recent weeks, a 'unity ride' planned for this weekend in memory of the popular member of the city's cycling community

item.title: "All our jobs remain": Sonder Bikes owner Alpkit saved by new owner after entering administration
item.description: All shareholdings have been voided but Alpkit insist stakes will be offered in the new company

item.title: "Badly executed" cycle lane under fire after broken wrists and lacerated kidney among reported injuries
item.description: Brighton & Hove City Council says it is sorry for the injuries caused but reiterated that cyclists should not be turning into the park at that point

item.title: Is this cyclist right to blame themself for near-collision in busy traffic? Rider hopes footage will help others "learn from my mistakes"; 100% legit Facebook Marketplace bike... (apparently); Blink twice if you need help, Tadej + more on the live blog
item.description: It's Thursday, which means Dan Alexander is back in the live blog hot seat for another day of rounding-up all the goings on in the world of cycling today

item.title: Gorewear M Women Base Layer Thermo Long Sleeve Shirt
item.description: Warm and comfortable base layer, though there are some compromises with odour control 8/10

item.title: “I blindly get on the bike every time and just hope I get home alive”: Mayor says “car-centric” cycle lane cuts are impeding road safety plans and putting cyclists in danger
item.description: “People want to cycle, even though they know they are taking their lives in their hands,” Drogheda mayor Michelle Hall said, claiming the Irish government’s active travel funding cuts are “not going to get people out of cars”
